title: Tools
subtitle: Register, test, and publish business tools.
sectionNote: Host, port, and auth belong to service connections. Tools focus on name, endpoint, I/O contracts, retries, timeouts, and publish tests.
noTestPerm: No test permission in this workspace
batchTestTitle: Batch-test selected tools with default inputs
forcePublishTitle: Platform admin: skip live tests and force-publish unpublished tools (server allowForcePublish required)
emptyBody: Register a tool or import drafts from OpenAPI.
noMatchBody: Try different name, status, or path keywords.
govReviewDesc: Saved; waiting for test or publish readiness
govTestedDesc: Last test passed; not published to agents yet
govTestFailDesc: Last test failed; fix and retry
govWaitTestDesc: Not tested yet; required before publish
govTestUnknownDesc: No test record; do not infer pass from published status
govRunDisabledDesc: Tool disabled; run status not updated
govConnUnknownDesc: Failed to load connection catalog; retry
govConnMigrateDesc: Connection must be migrated before calls
govCredExpiringDesc: Service connection credentials are about to expire
govNoObsDesc: No run health, volume, or failure metrics yet
govPublishedUnsafe: Published but not safe to call; fix the service connection first
govReasonError: Service connection verification failed or is unhealthy
govReasonAttention: Service connection needs attention (auth, migration, or config)
govReasonDefault: Service connection unavailable or auth needs attention
backoffFixedDesc: Wait a fixed duration between retries; good for stable APIs.
backoffExponentialDesc: Increase wait after each failure; good for rate limits or congestion.
backoffLinearDesc: Increase wait by a fixed step each time; gentler ramp-up.
rateStandardDesc: Up to 60 calls per minute; fits most business APIs.
rateConservativeDesc: Up to 30 calls per minute; for costly or fragile downstreams.
rateHighDesc: Up to 120 calls per minute; for stable, read-heavy APIs.
statusHelper: Status is driven by test, publish, and disable actions; after runtime config changes, the system may roll back per backend rules.
sampleToolDescription: Intercept a shipment that has not left the warehouse
descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the business action this tool performs
noTestRecordDetail: No test record yet. Run a test first.
allChecksPassedDetail: Connectivity, response schema, error mapping, and runtime policy all passed.
failedChecksDetail: Failed: {checks}. Open the test dialog to inspect the downstream response, fix issues, and retry.
testNotPassedDetail: Test did not pass. Open the test dialog for the downstream response and error details.
publishNeedsTest: A passing test is required before publish.
disabledCanRepublish: Currently disabled, but you can republish directly.
testPassedCanPublish: Last test passed; ready to publish.
disabledNeedRetest: Disabled; enabling returns it to review. Re-test and publish to open it to agents.
agentBindUnavailable: Not published; no agent binding entry yet
riskDescForceBatch: Skip live tests and force-publish {count} unpublished tools (create and activate formal releases). Upstream DELETE/mutating APIs are not called, but contract errors may go live for agents. Provide a reason and confirm impact.
riskDescBatchDeletePublished: Delete {count} selected tools ({published} published). This cannot be undone; published items may affect agent bindings and workflow calls.
riskDescBatchDeleteDraft: Delete {count} selected tools. None have formal releases; impact is mainly drafts and config records.
riskDescDeletePublished: Deletion cannot be undone. If agents or workflows reference this tool’s published version, related calls may fail. Confirm impact first.
riskDescDeleteDraft: This tool has no formal release. Deletion mainly affects this draft and version history and usually does not break live agent bindings.
riskDescDisablePublished: After disable, agents and workflows that depend on this tool’s published version can no longer call it. Confirm impact.
riskDescDisableDraft: After disable, this tool cannot be selected; it is not published, so impact is mainly configuration-side.
riskDescEnable: After enable, this tool can be bound and called again (still subject to publish state and bindings).
riskValueForceBinding: Callable by agents / workflows after publish
riskValueNonePublished: None published; usually no active bindings
riskValueSkipTest: Skip live tests; write force-pass attest records
riskValueWorkflowMayRef: May be referenced by published workflows; spot-check recommended
riskValueNoWorkflow: None published; usually no production references
riskValueMayBindCheck: Bindings may exist; check agent capability bindings
riskValueNotPublishedBind: Not published; usually no active bindings
riskValueWorkflowCheck: May be referenced by published workflows; verify in workflows
riskValueNotPublishedWorkflow: Not published; usually no production references
publishNeedsPassingTest: A passing test is required before publish
batchNeedPassthroughToken: Selection includes passthrough connections; enter a one-time business token first.
batchExpiresTooSoon: Expiry must be at least 2 minutes after the current time.
batchSkipHint: Skipped items are often published-only versions or missing connections.
editCreatesDraft: Editing a published tool creates a new draft version from that release; the original release stays unchanged.
unsavedLeaveConfirm: This tool has unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
completeRequiredStep: Complete required fields for the current step first.
hintNestedContract: {tab} often has nested objects. Expand the field tree and edit properties on the right.
hintErrorMapping: Map protocol statuses and error codes to advice agents can understand and act on.
hintFlatContract: Path / Query / Header are usually flat key-value pairs; a table is faster to fill.
saveExists: Tool already exists. Check the name or edit the existing tool.
saveConnectionMissing: Service connection not found. Select an available connection first.
saveWorkspaceMissing: Workspace not found. Re-select from the dropdown.
saveFailedRetry: Failed to save tool. Check the fields and retry.
publishNeedTestFeedback: A passing test is required before publish.
enabledKeepTest: {name} was enabled; passing test retained. Republish to open it to agents.
enabledToReview: {name} was enabled and returned to review.
savedAsDraftFeedback: {name} was saved as a tool draft. Test before publish.
publishBlocked: Publish checklist has blocking items. Fix them before publishing.
publishWarningsConfirm: Publish checklist still has warnings. Continue publishing?
checkBaseInfoDetail: Tool name, description, and maintainer must be set.
checkRequestContractDetail: At least one named input is required, or explicitly none.
checkResponseContractDetail: Every response field needs a name and type.
checkLatestTestNeed: A passing test is required before publish.
checkRetryDetail: Retry count and backoff policy must be set.
checkAgentImpactDetail: Backend does not yet list agent/workflow references; confirm impact manually before publish.
autoPaginationDescription: Auto-filled pagination parameter (when not declared in OpenAPI)
editorSubtitle: Configure a business API action agents can call
sectionBasicsHelp: Used for agent recognition and team management
sectionActionHelp: Host and auth are inherited from the service connection
inheritConnectionHelp: Domain, base path, and auth are inherited together.
draftAfterSave: After save it becomes a draft; continue test and publish on the detail page.
requestBodyDesc: Use the field tree for nested structures; JSON is a read-only derived preview.
successResponseDesc: Describe response fields agents can read and reference.
errorMappingDesc: Translate protocol errors into advice agents can understand and act on.
agentAdvicePlaceholder: Stop and escalate for human confirmation
noErrorMappings: No error mappings yet. Click “Add mapping” to start.
confirmSaveDraftHelp: Live test and publish continue on the tool detail page after save.
advancedRuntimeHelp: Defaults work for most HTTP tools
saveAsDraftNoteBody: Drafts are not opened to agents immediately. Save, then test on the detail page and publish after pass.
testMethodHelp: Open the test dialog, fill default inputs, and run a live call.
testDialogHelp: Default test inputs are generated from the parameter contract. Edit them, then run.
testBlockedPublishedOnly: Only a published version exists; retest is blocked. Edit the tool to create a new draft version, then run the test.
passthroughNeedToken: Passthrough connections require a one-time business token and connection.
expiresInvalid: Invalid expiry format. Select again (local time).
expiresTooSoon: Expiry must be at least 2 minutes after the current time (current value is expired or too soon).
outboundExpired: Outbound token envelope expired: set expiry after now (suggest +1 hour) and paste the business token again.
outboundInvalid: Outbound credentials invalid: check the token is non-empty without newlines, the connection matches, and expiry is in the future. Do not add a Bearer prefix.
credentialInvalid: Service connection credentials invalid or expired: {detail}. Update credentials on the service connection and retest.
outboundPassthroughHelp: Token is write-only and is not stored in test results, history, or local storage.
flatDescPath: Path parameters map to brace placeholders in the URL; usually few and non-nested.
flatDescQuery: Query parameters appended after the URL, e.g. ?status=active.
flatDescHeader: Request headers for auth, tracing, and similar scenarios.
flatEmpty: No parameters yet. Click “Add field” below to start.
hybridEmpty: No fields yet. Click “Add field” to start.
selectFieldHint: Select a field on the left to view properties.
jsonPreviewCaption: Read-only preview · generated from the field tree. Switch back to “Structured” to edit.
forceReasonPlaceholder: e.g. Live DELETE calls are unsafe in production; contract was verified in staging.
batchTestHeading: Test selected tools with default inputs
batchTestDescription: Run tests in order for {count} selected tools. Path/Query defaults are auto-filled (e.g. pageNum=1, pageSize=10). Only pass/fail counts are summarized.
batchNoteDraftOnly: Only editable drafts are tested (published tools without a new draft are skipped)
batchNoteMissingConn: Tools without a connection are skipped
batchNotePassthrough: Passthrough connections need one business token applied to all passthrough items
outboundBatchHelp: Token is write-only and is not stored in history or local storage. Do not add a Bearer prefix.
